ops.catering: The facility has its own food and beverage division (restaurant division), and food and drinks are provided by the facility. The Terms of Use state "Please refrain from bringing food and drinks from outside the facility," and the Party Terms of Use prohibit "bringing in food and drinks, and taking home food and drinks served." Parties are applied for separately using a "food and beverage application form." (Source: Terms of Use and Party Terms of Use PDF, as of February 9, 2015)
ops.restaurants: The restaurant "Something Delicious" on 3F is described in a notice dated March 5, 2025 as "currently not open to the general public." The glass-walled foyer on 5F is intended for post-conference parties and cocktail receptions; use for exhibitions or parties is paid (quote required). Party use is 17:00-21:00 on weekdays and 12:00-21:00 on Sat, Sun & holidays, for up to 2 hours (Party Terms of Use, as of February 9, 2015).
ops.loadingHours: Standard operating hours are 9:00-21:00. Early morning (8:00-9:00) is available for a fee in 1-hour units (priced per room, e.g. Hall (entire) ¥126,000). Hours outside this are by consultation. Consult the facility in advance when bringing equipment or fixtures into a room (Terms of Use 5(2), as of February 9, 2015).
ops.parking: Parking is by advance reservation; consult the facility when using it (Terms of Use 5(3), as of February 9, 2015).
